parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale accurately addresses all four error targets: it recognizes that HPAS and BAP are explicitly named as unique aspects, corrects the mischaracterization of the comment as purely general, properly notes the specificity of the issues raised, and revises the rubric classification to one consistent with partial grounding plus clear specificity. It preserves the original observation that no section/table/figure number is cited, does not invent evidence, avoids stating a numeric score or gold label, and reads coherently as a rationale for rescoring.
